meta.promptText: India mein acne wali skin ke liye 700 rupees ke andar konsa serum kharidun?

response.text:
Haan — **₹700 ke andar acne-prone skin ke liye meri first choice The Derma Co Sali-Cinamide Anti-Acne Serum** hogi. Isme **2% Salicylic Acid + 5% Niacinamide** hai, jo clogged pores/active acne ke saath oiliness aur acne marks ko target karta hai. Brand ki site par abhi 30 ml ₹449 listed hai. ### Mere picks
1. **Best overall:** The Derma Co Sali-Cinamide — **₹449** [thedermaco.com](https://thedermaco.com/products/sali-cinamide-anti-acne-serum-with-2-salicylic-acid-5-niacinamide-30ml?utm_source=chatgpt.com)
2. **Budget option:** Minimalist 2% Salicylic Acid — around **₹494** currently listed. [www.nykaa.com](https://www.nykaa.com/dp/serum-for-open-pores?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

### [The Derma Co. 2% Salicylic Acid Face Serum]()
*₹237*

**Agar tumhare main problem active pimples + blackheads/whiteheads hai → 2% salicylic acid choose karo.** Agar mostly **acne ke baad dark marks** hain aur pimples kam hain, niacinamide/azelaic-acid based serum better fit ho sakta hai.

Salicylic serum ko initially **2–3 raat/week** lagao, moisturizer use karo, aur daytime **SPF 30–50 sunscreen** zaroor. Ek saath multiple strong actives mat start karna.

Agar tum bata do **skin oily/dry/combination hai aur acne active pimples hain ya acne marks**, main ₹700 ke andar **ek exact serum** recommend kar dunga.
